releaseNotes:
• Added Company Store (Chigrawati) + Pilkhana Site 1, Umrari Site 2, and Harjipura Site 3 with 1-tap Google Maps
• Made site saving & cloud sync non-blocking on poor rural signal and serialized with Mutex
• Prevented re-seeding defaults after intentional delete-all and fixed transient Firestore getDocument update handling
• Fixed Edit-dialog GPS fallback and added /place/lat,lng + inline parenthesis URL+GPS parser support
